noTracking.title: No Cookies, No Tracking
noTracking.description: Bazar does not use cookies, tracking pixels, or any other tracking technologies on this website. We respect your privacy and believe in a clean, cookie-free browsing experience.

whatAre.title: What Are Cookies?
whatAre.description: Cookies are small text files that websites typically store on your device to remember information about you, such as your preferences, login status, or browsing behavior.

ourApproach.title: Our Approach
ourApproach.description: We have deliberately chosen not to implement any cookies or tracking mechanisms on our website. This means:

benefits.noCookies: No cookies are stored on your device
benefits.noTracking: No tracking of your browsing behavior
benefits.noAds: No advertising cookies or third-party trackers
benefits.noAnalytics: No analytics cookies (we use server-side analytics only)

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.description: While our website itself doesn't use cookies, please note that if you interact with external services (such as embedded videos or social media content), those services may have their own cookie policies.

browserSettings.title: Browser Settings
browserSettings.description: Since we don't use cookies, you don't need to adjust your browser settings for our website. However, you can always configure your browser to block cookies from other websites if desired.

futureChanges.title: Future Changes
futureChanges.description: Should we ever decide to implement cookies in the future, we will update this policy and notify users accordingly. Any such changes would be made with user privacy as our top priority.

contact.title: Questions?
contact.description: If you have any questions about our cookie policy or privacy practices, please feel free to contact us through the contact information provided on our main website.

commitment.title: Our Privacy Commitment
commitment.description: Bazar is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparent data practices. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our web application.

account.title: Account Information
account.description: When you create an account with Bazar, we collect:
account.name: Full name (for personalization)
account.profile: Profile information you choose to provide

session.title: Session Data
session.description: To provide a seamless experience, we maintain session data including:

usage.title: Usage Information
usage.description: We collect aggregated usage data to improve our services:

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUse.service: Provide and maintain our e-commerce platform
dataUse.account: Manage your account and authenticate users
dataUse.improve: Improve our services and develop new features

location.title: Storage Location
location.description: Your data is stored on secure servers with industry-standard encryption and access controls.

session.title: Session Management
session.description: Session data is temporarily stored in your browser's local storage and automatically expires after periods of inactivity for security purposes.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.description: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties except in the following limited circumstances:
dataSharing.service: With service providers who assist in app functionality (under strict confidentiality agreements)
dataSharing.legal: When required by law or to protect our legal rights

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.description: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:
userRights.delete: Request deletion of your account and data
userRights.export: Export your data in a portable format

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.description: We retain your information only as long as necessary to provide our services and fulfill legal obligations. Session data is automatically cleared upon logout or after extended periods of inactivity.

minors.title: Children's Privacy
minors.description: Bazar is not intended for use by children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

changes.title: Policy Changes
changes.description: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify users of any material changes via email or through the application interface.

contact.title: Contact Information
contact.description: If you have questions about this privacy policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us through the contact information provided on our main website.
